items.html: And behold, even during the time of the dormita the female is not asleep, for then the Mochin depart from ZA and enter the female, in order to build and correct her Partzuf, so that she may be able to return face to face, as is known in the matter of the discourse of the Shofar of Rosh Hashanah. And necessarily there is this illumination and providence over Israel from her side; and the matter of that illumination was the matter of Mordechai the righteous, as we shall explain, with the help of God.
